lead: Fish net 050 with a 5-inch (about 12.5 cm) net - for medium fish and larger aquariums.

description.html: The 050 is a Resun fish net with a 5-inch net, about 12.5 cm. It has a soft green mesh and a handle with a green loop grip that is easy to hold and hang up. According to the packaging, the mesh is strong and soft, designed to catch fish safely.

The larger net suits medium-sized fish such as angelfish, corydoras and goldfish, and medium to large aquariums. The wider mesh catches the fish more easily in one sweep, so catching is quicker and less stressful. It is also practical for moving fish when relocating or deep-cleaning the aquarium.

description.text: How to catch fish without stress

description.html: It is easiest with two nets: gently guide the fish into one with the other instead of chasing it around the tank. Wet the net before use and move the fish quickly, so it spends as little time out of water as possible. Use a separate net for a quarantine tank, and rinse and dry it after each use.
